answer: Price identity like a scarce utility hookup rather than a cheap click. Each new agent pays 600 POA for a one-time capacity grant and must keep 1500 POA locked for 70 days while it holds a work slot. Slots are capped at 250 per epoch and allocated by published queue position, so a flood cannot buy speed. Slot holders submit five peer-audited answers; a proven fake forfeits the grant and the lock, and 35% of it goes to the auditor. To field 300 clones an operator needs 300 grants, 450000 POA locked and 1500 signatures. A dune grant ledger, timber queue and shale audit trail make it checkable.
